segments.name: Active Group
segments.description: Designs, markets and licenses outdoor, running and activewear brands for consumers of casual and performance footwear and apparel.
segments.evidence: Active Group, consisting of Merrell ® footwear and apparel, Saucony ® footwear and apparel, Sweaty Betty ® activewear, and Chaco ® footwear

segments.name: Work Group
segments.description: Supplies work boots, uniform and safety footwear for workers, tradespeople and first responders worldwide.
segments.evidence: Work Group, consisting of Wolverine ® footwear and apparel, Cat ® footwear, Bates ® uniform footwear, Harley-Davidson ® footwear and HYTEST ® safety footwear

segments.name: Other
segments.description: Houses remaining brands, licensing, sourcing, leather marketing and multi-brand retail not included in the reportable segments.
segments.evidence: The Other category consists of Sperry ® footwear, Keds ® footwear, Hush Puppies ® footwear and apparel, the Company's leather marketing operations, sourcing operations that include third-party commission revenues, multi-branded direct-to-consumer retail stores and the Stride Rite ® licensed business.

revenueModel.text: The Company earns revenue from selling branded footwear, apparel and accessories to third-party customers, from third-party distributors, licensees and joint ventures, and from its direct-to-consumer businesses.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue for the reportable segments includes revenue from the sale of branded footwear, apparel and accessories to third-party customers; revenue from third-party distributors, licensees and joint ventures; and revenue from the Company's direct-to-consumer businesses.

changes.text: In 2024 the Company sold the global Sperry business to Authentic Brands Group LLC.
changes.evidence: Effective January 10, 2024 the Company sold the global Sperry ® business to Authentic Brands Group LLC.

changes.text: In 2023 the Company sold the global Keds business to Designer Brands, Inc.
changes.evidence: Effective February 4, 2023 the Company sold the global Keds ® business to Designer Brands, Inc.

changes.text: In 2023 the Company sold the Wolverine Leathers Division in two separate transactions.
changes.evidence: The Wolverine Leathers Division was sold in two separate transactions in 2023.
